Summary
: The English translation of the Brahma Sutras with the commentary of Nimbarka, known as the Vedanta Parijata Saurabha, as well as the sub-commentary of Shrinivasa, known as the Vedanta Kaustubha. Both treatises are essential for understanding the doctrine of Nimbarka, which exposes Dvaitadvaita (dualistic non-dualism) Vedanta.
This edition also includes numerous footnotes and comparative sections including views from Shankara, Ramanuja, Shrikantha, Bhaskara and Baladeva .
Alternative titles: Brahma-sūtra, Brahmasūtra, Vedānta-sūtra, Vedāntasūtra, Vedānta-parijāta-saurabha, Vedāntaparijātasaurabha, Vedānta-kaustubha and Vedāntakaustubha.
